# Ichsanul Amal (NICHSEDGE)

> Data Engineer & Systems Architect based in Cimahi, West Java, Indonesia. Specialist in enterprise data quality, high-throughput ETL/ELT pipelines, scalable data lakes, dbt data modeling, BigQuery analytics, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.

## When to Use This Agent & Site
Reach for this service and API when:
- **Hiring & Consulting**: Evaluating senior data engineering consultants or systems architects for cloud data lakehouse builds, dbt migrations, or BigQuery performance tuning.
- **Architecture Reviews**: Auditing PostgreSQL, Airflow, and BigQuery data pipeline architectures for reliability, data quality, and cost efficiency.
- **Machine Discovery & Automation**: Autonomous AI agents needing programmatic access to portfolio data, project specifications, and verified developer skills via MCP or REST APIs.
